# Issue 3535. The reporter's configuration: a vertex shader whose entry point
# takes a struct parameter. No flags beyond target and entry point, because the
# issue names none.
#
# vs_6_0 is the oldest vertex profile in the release sequence, per SKILL.md's
# "target the repro at the oldest profile and flag set that still shows the
# symptom" -- every release from v1.4.1907 on can compile it.
#
# With no -Fo, dxc prints the compiled result's disassembly to stdout. That
# text is the instrument: DXC's disassembler renders the container's reflection
# data as the "; Buffer Definitions:" comment block, so HLSL struct member
# names that reflection carries appear there. manual-case-witnesses.txt section
# 3 proves it -- strip the reflection part and the names vanish while the
# module is otherwise unchanged.
-T vs_6_0 -E VS repro.hlsl
